name: tracker-inbox-access
goal: Open the direct Tracker inbox from a signed-in phone home and return to home without a model, including when its paired computer is offline.

evidence: The signed-in phone home had no link to the Tracker route. The browser verified the page was present and then timed out waiting for a Needs you link.
Extended the existing paired iOS home and Project Overview case to open Needs you and return to Harness.
